sample_unit: online patient education materials (plus 3 interactions each with ChatGPT and Google Gemini)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM outputs and web PEMs versus AMA sixth-grade guideline
links.effect: Only 16.1% of PEMs met the sixth-grade level by FKGL; no LLM outputs achieved this standard; ChatGPT post-graduate level, Gemini college level.
links.quote: Only 16.1% of PEMs met the AMA's sixth-grade readability recommendation using the FKGL readability index, and no LLM outputs achieved this standard.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education outputs relative to plain-language target
links.effect: ChatGPT and Gemini outputs were classified at post-graduate and college reading levels, respectively; PEMs at 10th-12th grade FRE level.
links.quote: The mean FRE score for PEMs corresponded to a 10th- to 12th-grade reading level, whereas ChatGPT and Google Gemini outputs were classified at post-graduate and college reading levels, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the baseline readability, quality, and reliability of LLM outputs (ChatGPT and Gemini) for patient education on Meniere's disease without testing any deployment practices or safeguards.
